Schöberl leaves major steps of the triangle extension proof as exercises; Vohralík says the further development behind its hp rate is not detailed; and He et al. import prior approximation results. ([Schöberl](https://jschoeberl.github.io/iFEM/pversion/hpfem.html), [Vohralík](https://who.rocq.inria.fr/Martin.Vohralik/Enseig/FEM/FEM.pdf), [He et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.18569))

The aggregate cross-batch ledger check is blocked by a pre-existing batch-11 ownership mismatch involving a page now assigned to batch 16; the exact evidence is in the notes. The read-only autopilot status still shows the run active and held for owner repair and recertification. These authoring records are not independent approval.
